body:
## Summary

Wires `/sc:reflect` into **both** tasklist-generating pipelines, adding an executor-disjoint reflection layer that closes the same-frame rf-qa blindspot documented in `feedback_sc_reflect_vs_inline_rfqa`. Implements both design proposals (`reflect-in-task-builder.md`, `reflect-in-sc-tasklist.md`) as strictly-additive markdown edits, plus the S4 token-set trim.

### task-builder (Proposal 1)
- New **A.10.7 PRE reflect gate** — advisory-blocking, `Skill sc:reflect-protocol`, never auto-mutates (`feedback_human_decision_items_must_halt`)
- `--spec` thread (A.2 `SPEC_PATH`) + frontmatter `spec_path`/`reflect_pre`/`reflect_post`
- A.9 BUILD_REQUEST `POST_REFLECT_GATE` field + **Critical Rule #19** (MALFORMED-on-omission)
- Templated fresh-session **POST reflect item** (penultimate, HALT) + A.11 `REFLECT GATES` block
- New deterministic **Tasklist Complexity Score (TCS)** section (depth mapping + O1–O4 overrides)
- S4 token-set trim → `{after Phase \d+, depends_on:}`

### sc-tasklist-protocol (Proposal 2)
- New **Stage 10.5 pre-reflect fan-out** (N parallel agents, fenced after the patch chain)
- Templated **terminal POST reflect task** per phase (Tier EXEMPT) + `phase-template.md` mirror
- Per-phase deterministic **COMPLEXITY_SCORE** (`multifile` signal dropped)
- Four checkpoint-is-last invariants (#6/#18/#19/#20) amended together
- `--no-reflect` escape hatch (command Usage/Arguments + skill `argument-hint`)
- Index **Pre-Reflect Sign-off** column + `reflect_pre_summary` + `index-template.md` mirror
- `validation/reflect-pre|post/` + `depth-map.yaml` directory convention

## Validation
- **Regression** subset baseline-equivalent (0 green→red; the 28 `TestCanonicalFixtureParity` failures are a pre-existing worktree fixture artifact)
- `make verify-sync` **GREEN**; markdownlint **clean**
- Independently audited by **`/sc:reflect --mode post`** (run `post-TASK-RF-20260604-042055-20260604T120400`): deviations **Authorized 1 / Necessary 0 / Drift 0 / Regression 0**

## Notes
- Built + executed via the dogfood work-unit `TASK-RF-20260604-042055` (included under `.dev/`, with both PRE and POST reflect reports).
- Separately labelled **17 pre-existing unlabeled fences** (MD040, already shipped in `origin/master`) as `text` to pass the local markdownlint pre-commit hook — no behavioral change; regression unaffected.
